=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1025-1028 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: jq -Rs on potentially multi-line comment_body produces { "body": [...] } where body is a JSON array of raw input lines, but GitHub /issues/{num}/comments API requires body as a JSON string.
  WHY: The claimed array-shaped payload would be rejected by the API, causing the post to fail.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1019-1027 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The inline comment claims `-Rs` reads the body as a single raw string and that `printf` being a bash builtin is the reason the cap is avoided.
  WHY: One reviewer flagged that the builtin detail is incidental and the real fix is the stdin pipe, so the comment can mislead readers about why the workaround works.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:post_tracking_comment() after jq step (~line 1029)
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: No validation of produced JSON payload shape before gh api POST; jq exit 0 accepts but invalid {body: array} passes unchecked.
  WHY: The payload can reach gh api even when the JSON shape is wrong, so a malformed request would only fail downstream.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:gh api call (~line 1030+)
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: gh api failure (e.g. 422) not captured; function continues as if success.
  WHY: A failed POST can be treated as successful, so the comment never posts and the orchestrator can continue from stale state.
